unselected_live_tests.head: 437053f80d5ebebce950602b168901bfe6591483
unselected_live_tests.purpose: Reconcile all six collected live tests not selected in the 91-case MS validation plan. Related coverage is not execution of the omitted case.

inventory.selected_live_completion: Recorded by the separate accepted-live-run evidence; this classification does not certify its completion.

assertions_in_unexecuted_test: SDK reads default emission weights and validator floor; rejects a below-floor plan before signing.
Submitting a 45% validator share freezes the predicted TAO weight while preserving the root share.
Restoring defaults clears the override when the owner rate-limit window permits.
cases.relationship_to_ms_validation: Uses the existing classical Alice wallet. This is emission allocation economics and SDK planning, not an ML-DSA-specific assertion. The generic dispatch matrix is not proof of these business-state outcomes.
not_repeated_as_this_live_test: No live SDK plan/submit/read reconciliation of the emission TAO-weight prediction in this validation run; related unit and runtime tests are not a substitute for that integration result.

assertions_in_unexecuted_test: CLI JSON show, invalid and valid dry runs, and real set-value submission against a live subnet.
Post-submit root share and effective TAO weight match the preview; owner-window rejection uses the expected exit code.
cases.relationship_to_ms_validation: Uses a classical Alice disk wallet and emission allocation commands. General MS CLI wallet/transaction coverage does not establish this specific command flow.
not_repeated_as_this_live_test: The emission CLI was tested offline with fixtures, not in this omitted live test. No live emission-CLI prediction or exit-code result is claimed.

assertions_in_unexecuted_test: Fresh chain begins disabled; an ordinary signed admin toggle is denied.
Sudo toggles True/False/True/False and SDK/storage reads agree without changing spec_version.
cases.relationship_to_ms_validation: Directly relevant to hashed/MS activation. Completed live gates cover pause/resume and ordinary sr/ed availability; real-runtime Rust tests cover default-off and root-only origin.
not_repeated_as_this_live_test: The exact fresh-chain four-toggle sequence, SDK hashed_accounts_enabled parity, and explicit unchanged spec_version assertion were not rerun as this live test. Root-only denial was executed in the real-runtime Rust test, not claimed as this live RPC result.

assertions_in_unexecuted_test: Owner switches Null/Yuma/Null and preserves/restores validator limits.
Raw 3:1 weights produce the expected miner emission ratio, and Null preserves bonds and weights.
Owner batch trimming updates the UID cap and restores a bounded Yuma validator limit.
cases.relationship_to_ms_validation: Full consensus/emission accounting is broader than the new key type. Both MS profiles did live owner-authorized Yuma and Null non-self/raw weight dispatch, but that does not prove the omitted complete emission cycle.
not_repeated_as_this_live_test: No live 3:1 emission-ratio assertion, complete Null/Yuma/Null cycle, or trim-and-return sequence from this named test was executed. These remain runtime-test evidence rather than a live integration claim.

assertions_in_unexecuted_test: SDK mines and submits PoW for an unfunded classical coldkey without charging a fee, changing burn, or creating collateral.
A separate real CLI wallet registers unfunded; population, ownership, replay watermark, and owner PoW-toggle rules are checked.
cases.relationship_to_ms_validation: The MS-sensitive unfunded PoW path was executed by the normal CLI across plain sr/ed, hashed sr/ed, fixed MS and rotating MS. Protected storage registration is sponsored separately; the coldkey stays at zero free balance during PoW admission.
not_repeated_as_this_live_test: The omitted test combines direct mine_pow_registration SDK submission, separate CLI registration, unchanged burn/collateral/replay-watermark assertions and owner toggles in one live scenario. The completed six-mode lifecycle asserts zero free balance, owner/UID registration and protected generation; the other listed invariants have separate Rust evidence.

assertions_in_unexecuted_test: SDK encrypts a commitment for a future drand round and submits the inner ciphertext using a hotkey.
The chain reveals the expected plaintext with a nonzero reveal block and removes the pending CommitmentOf entry.
cases.relationship_to_ms_validation: Both fixed and rotating MS hotkeys executed this SDK encryption/Commitments.set_commitment/drand-reveal path, with finalized plaintext checks. The omitted standalone test uses classical Alice.
not_repeated_as_this_live_test: The standalone classical hotkey test itself was not run. The MS live tests do not repeat its explicit post-reveal CommitmentOf-is-None assertion or ciphertext-versus-envelope inequality; cleanup and inner-envelope handling have separate Rust coverage.

unselected_live_tests.source_review_limit: Source review maps overlapping assertions to verified passing test evidence. It does not establish complete integration equivalence, successful semantics for every call in the dispatch matrix, or execution of any of these six omitted live cases.

portable_receipt_scope.scope: Canonical finalized RPC verification transcript with unique chain/block/index references, extrinsic hashes, event hashes and expected inner/outer failures. Includes recorded setup/superseded-attempt receipts; not a claim that every transaction in every suite is inventoried. Mixed, Shield and RPC suites have separate result evidence.
portable_receipt_scope.proof_limit: No GRANDPA justification/storage trie proof is embedded. Without retained local chain state, this transcript and its hashes are not independently replayable consensus proofs.

superseded_fixture_attempts.reason: Corrected canonical event loading for normalized failed receipts; all three cases rerun.
Added metadata-hash to the same-head functional fixture required by Vault; all 24 cases rerun.
Stopped before late uncapped registrations; added explicit consent and reran all six modes.
Corrected SCALE Ok-unit representation assertion; both modes rerun.

boundaries: Functional activation uses the documented five-file test weight overlay; production Weight::MAX gates remain. No reference weights or production capacity result is claimed.

Both mainnet build-feature rehearsals use the authenticated snapshot at block 9290353, approximately 49 hours old at execution, and ten synthetic blocks each. They are not a fresh snapshot or a complete historical/future transaction replay; no Srtool bit-identical release artifact is claimed.
Finalize descriptor-account registration before public disclosure or bare funding, under the accepted operational rule.

The 1292 Executive cases test authentication and dispatch parity for 323 native call variants using plain sr25519, plain ed25519, fixed MS and rotating MS. Hashed sr/ed are not matrix modes. Minimal fixtures do not establish successful business semantics for every operation; two uninhabited calls and the self-contained Ethereum call have separate boundaries.
Forty-seven Rust tests remain ignored and are classified separately; none is claimed passed. The CI type-check policy permits warnings, retained in its fresh log.
Real signing, SCALE decoding and finalized dispatch tests are not external certification, side-channel certification, formal proof, or an absolute no-loss guarantee.

The 7200-block EVM association cooldown was preserved. Live normal-slot lifecycle cases prove early rejection. A separate passing default-feature Executive test covers rejection at 7199 and success at 7200 across all six wallet modes; it is not a live 7200-block wait.

Current and legacy Python native libraries support metadata V14/V15 but not V16; tested JavaScript decoders pass V14/V15/V16. No graphical Polkadot.js application or every historical client was tested.
Raw Ethereum RLP uses secp256k1; MS EVM operations use native EVM call/create routes.
The pre-existing Ethereum receipt effectiveGasPrice discrepancy is separate from verified actual debit and this PR regression assessment.
Vault tests simulate the external phone response. No physical hardware wallet, sustained adversarial load/capacity test, or remote GitHub CI run is established by this local evidence.

Portable files exclude wallet keyfiles, node databases, binaries and the large mainnet snapshot. Exact hashes identify omitted artifacts but cannot substitute for their contents when reproducing the run.
